title: Tide 2 plus 2
description: Adds some more mod compatibility for Tide 2
body:
A datapack that adds some more mod compat for [Tide 2](https://modrinth.com/mod/tide)
---
Currently adds compatibilty for:
- [Spawn](https://modrinth.com/mod/spawn-mod) (Herring, Angler Fish)
- [Environmental](https://modrinth.com/mod/environmental) (Koi)
- [Upgrade Aquatic](https://modrinth.com/mod/upgrade-aquatic) (Perch, Pike, Lionfish)
---
This datapack doesn't just add fish to the fishing journal. It also adds some extra gameplay elements compat, such as:

### Spawn
- Made clam meat a bait
- Added clams to the ocean crate loot table
- Added tags to tide fish (#tuna_feeds, #sunfish_feeds)

### Environmental
- Added tags to biomes (#has_cherry_grove_fish to Blossom Valleys and Blossom Woods)

### Upgrade Aquatic
- Added driftwood to the freshwater crate loot table
---

~~2+2=🐟~~
